paragraphs.text: DSH sidebar resource monitor (CPU/memory/frequency trends with 24h/7d history)
# dsh-resource-monitor · 资源监控
A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) sidebar plugin that samples your Windows machine **once a minute**, keeps a
**30-day** history, and tells you when sustained CPU load, memory pressure, or frequency throttling
actually happened — instead of showing a live gauge you have to stare at.
DSH 侧栏插件：每分钟采集一次本机资源，保留 30 天历史，直接用「连续多久超阈值」判定长期高占用、内存吃紧与降频，而不是只给一个需要一直盯着看的实时仪表盘。
## What it does / 功能
- Sidebar tab **资源监控**; a matching entry button also sits in the session title bar. / 侧栏 tab「资源监控」，会

话标题栏也有入口按钮。
- Panel order: KPI row, conclusion box, CPU chart (85% alert line), memory chart (90% al
ert line), frequency chart (70% throttle line), incident list. / 面板顺序：KPI、结论框、CPU 曲线（85% 告警线）、内存曲线（9

0% 告警线）、频率曲线（70% 降频线）、异常列表。
- KPI row: current CPU, current memory (used / total GB), current freque

ncy. / KPI：当前 CPU、当前内存（已用/总量 GB）、当前频率。
- Summary: range average/peak, minutes spent at ≥85% CPU, min

utes at ≥90% memory, throttled minutes. / 结论：区间平均/峰值、超阈值累计分钟、降频分钟。
- Incident list (last 7 days): CP
U sustained load, memory near capacity, frequency held down under load. / 异常列表（近 7 天）：CPU 长时间高占用、内存接

近上限、负载下降频。
- 24h / 7d toggle, auto-refresh every 30 s. / 24 小时 / 7 天切换，30 秒自动刷新。
## Detection rules / 判定规则
| Item / 项目 | Rule / 规则 |

| Sample interval / 采样间隔 | 60 s |
| Retention / 历史保留 | 30 days (`samples.jsonl`, append-only) |
| CP

U alert | ≥ 85% for ≥ 10 consecutive minutes |
| Memory alert | ≥ 90% for ≥ 10 consecutive minutes |
| Throttle alert | CPU ≥ 50% while frequency ≤ 70% of maximum, for ≥ 5 consecutive minutes |
## Data sources / 数据来源

- CPU / memory: Node `os.cpus()` time deltas, `os.totalmem()` / `os.freemem()`.
- Frequency: Windows

performance counter `\Processor Information(_Total)\% of Maximum Frequency`.
- Disk: `\PhysicalDisk
(_Total)\Disk Read Bytes/sec`, `Disk Write Bytes/sec` (still sampled into the history, not charted).

/ 磁盘读写仍写入历史，但不再绘图。
- Network: `Get-NetAdapterStatistics` cumulative bytes, converted to a rate betw

een two samples (history only, not charted). / 网络同样只入库不绘图。
- Disk and network figures come from one
`powershell.exe` child process per sample (~2–4 s, async, never blocks the UI).
## No temperature readings / 不采集温度
Reading CPU core temperature on Windows (MSR / SMBus) needs a kernel driver. This plugin does not sh
ip or load one; it deliberately infers throttling from the **frequency / maximum-frequency ratio**,
which reflects the throttling event itself and needs no driver or elevation.
Windows 上读取 CPU 核心温度需要内核驱动。本插件不附带、也不加载任何驱动，改用「当前频率 / 最高频率」判定降频 —— 这个信号直接反映降频事实，且不需要驱动或提权。

## Changelog / 版本记录

- **1.1.2** — 结论框移到 CPU 曲线之上；面板顺序：KPI → 结论 → CPU → 内存 → 频率 → 事件。
- **1.1.1** — CPU 与内存拆成两张独立曲线（各带 85

% / 90% 告警线），移除磁盘与网络曲线。
- **1.1.0** — 插件更名为 dsh-resource-monitor（原 dsh-resource-alerts）。
- **1.0.2**

— 修复结论行的重复百分号；频率卡片增加 CPU 叠加线与 70% 降频基准线。
- **1.0.1** — 修复 exports 缺少根入口导致 DSH 无法导入。
